description: This file provides Windows compatibility functions for socket operations, including error translation, socket creation, connection, and polling, specifically for the 'sockcompat' implementation in the 'hiredis' dependency.

methods.name: _wsaErrorToErrno
methods.description: Converts Windows Sockets API error codes to POSIX errno values.

methods.name: _updateErrno
methods.description: Updates the global errno based on the last Windows socket error.

methods.name: _initWinsock
methods.description: Initializes Winsock library if not already initialized.

methods.name: win32_getaddrinfo
methods.description: Wrapper around getaddrinfo for Windows compatibility.

methods.name: win32_gai_strerror
methods.description: Returns error string for getaddrinfo errors.

methods.name: win32_socket
methods.description: Creates a socket with Windows compatibility.

methods.name: win32_ioctl
methods.description: Performs I/O control operations on sockets.

methods.name: win32_bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to an address.

methods.name: win32_connect
methods.description: Connects a socket to an address, translating WSAEWOULDBLOCK to EINPROGRESS.

methods.name: win32_getsockopt
methods.description: Gets socket options, with special handling for timeouts.

methods.name: win32_setsockopt
methods.description: Sets socket options, with special handling for timeouts.
